column1: # Berlinan's words for the screen reader (fm1-reader): the screen's text <TAB> what to say. "#" a number, "*" a
# word left out. tools/gen_words.py makes web/words/<id>.json (published with the site) and the link the
# FM-1 sends. Change a line and a new file is made: keep the old ones (devices in the wild point at them).
# "A" is the note: not the article (the reader says a capital A before a word as "a")
